method: WordNet synonym alternatives are attached to semantic dependency slots; each left frame yield is matched against an independently lexicalized right frame under an exact character equation.

provenance.source: WordNet lemma inventories plus wordfreq frequency floor

next_repair: Carry agreement and subcategorization features through the same synonym lattice, then add an inflectional realization layer; this is a new repair to semantic-slot closure, not a reservoir or reverse-segmentation replay.
reader_gate: No row is reader evidence. Any mechanically admitted row must be manually screened for intact prose and frozen with randomized intact/shuffled controls before readers see it.
